title: Zero coefficients yield the zero polynomial
statement:
Let $K$ be a field and let $n, D \in \bbn$. Applying the low-degree squarefree polynomial construction to the identically zero coefficient function on $\mathcal{S}_{n,D}$ produces the zero element of the polynomial ring $K[X_0, \dots, X_{n-1}]$; that is,
\[
\sum_{\substack{s \subseteq \mathrm{Fin}\,n \\ \abs{s} \le D}} 0 \cdot \prod_{i \in s} X_i \;=\; 0 .
\]
replaced:
The constructor $\texttt{ACP.lowDegreeSquarefreePolynomial}$ sends the identically zero
coefficient function to the zero polynomial.
